changelog: - **A non-internship vertical no longer greets its users as "Internship CRM"** (#2355 follow-up). The brand wordmark falls back to the product name only for the INTERNSHIP vertical; a MARKETING (or any future) organization that has set no white-label brandName now falls back to its OWN name instead — `getOrgBranding()` reads the org's vertical and name and passes the name as `resolveBranding()`'s new `fallbackName` when the vertical is not INTERNSHIP. A tenant that has configured white-label branding is unaffected (a set brandName still wins); the INTERNSHIP product default is unchanged. Fixes a marketing tenant seeing the internship wordmark on its own admin panel after the marketing.ersah.in cutover.

en: A marketing organization that hasn't set a custom brand now shows its own name in the header instead of "Internship CRM".
tr: Özel marka belirlememiş bir pazarlama organizasyonu artık başlıkta "Internship CRM" yerine kendi adını gösteriyor.
de: Eine Marketing-Organisation ohne eigene Marke zeigt jetzt ihren eigenen Namen in der Kopfzeile statt "Internship CRM".
